steps.code:
# Parse the note content into song entries
lines = content.split('\n')[1:]  # skip the header line
songs = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line:
        continue
    # Split on " by " to get title and artists
    if ' by ' in line:
        title_part, artist_part = line.split(' by ', 1)
        title = title_part.strip()
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artist_part.split(',')]
        songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists})
    else:
        # If no " by ", treat whole line as title
        songs.append({'title': line.strip(), 'artists': []})

print(songs)
